# FCIOFLGenericModelWithSymmetry

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FCI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FCI/FCIOFLGenericModelWithSymmetry`

```text
FCIOFLGenericLatticeWithSymmetry, version 0.01

Usage: FCIOFLGenericLatticeWithSymmetry [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (default value = 4)
    -x, --nbr-points1 : number of unit cells along the 'x' (G1)-direction (default value = 3)
    -y, --nbr-points2 : number of unit cells along the 'y' (G2)-direction (default value = 3)
    --only-kx : only evalute a given x momentum sector (negative if all kx sectors have to be computed) (default value = -1)
    --only-ky : only evalute a given y momentum sector (negative if all ky sectors have to be computed) (default value = -1)
    --boson : use bosonic statistics instead of fermionic statistics
    --full-momentum : compute the spectrum for all momentum sectors, disregarding symmetries
    --u-potential : repulsive nearest neighbor potential strength (all/equal spin) (default value = 1)
    --spin-anisotropy : relative strength of inter-spin interactions (default value = 1)
    --depth : depth of the optical lattice (default value = 1)
    --cut-off-mode : cut-off for calculation: 0:Periodic, 1:Square, 2:circular  (default value = 0)
    --cut-off-momentum : maximum absolute momentum to be considered (circular case) (default value = 20)
    --precision-threshold : precision required in equality of symmetry related bands (default value = 1e-06)
    --nmax : cut-off for square or periodic case (units of enlarged unit cells)
    --gamma-x : boundary condition twisting angle along x (in 2 Pi unit) (default value = 0)
    --gamma-y : boundary condition twisting angle along y (in 2 Pi unit) (default value = 0)
    --flat-band : use flat band model
    -b, --nbr-bands : project onto the lowest #n energy bands (1 or 2) (default value = 2)
    --no-dispersion : use a model without dispersion and a contant gap of 10 between the two lowest bands
    --singleparticle-spectrum : only compute the one body spectrum
    --singleparticle-curvature : compute the Berry curvature of the lowest band (only available in singleparticle-spectrum mode)
    --singleparticle-chernnumber : compute the Chern number of the fully filled band (only available in singleparticle-spectrum mode)
    --export-onebody : export the one-body information (band structure and eigenstates) in a binary file
    --export-onebodytext : export the one-body information (band structure and eigenstates) in an ASCII text file
    --export-onebodyname : optional file name for the one-body information output
    --output-nbr-bands : number of bands to include in output files (default value = 10)
    --eigenvalue-file : filename for eigenvalues output
    --eigenstate-file : filename for eigenstates output; to be appended by _kx_#_ky_#.#.vec
    --show-hamiltonian : show Hamiltonian matrix, and exit
    --test-hermitian : Check hermitian symmetry, and exit

flux lattice options:
    -L, --lattice-definition : File defining the geometry of the lattice
    --external-parameters : values of external parameters for lattice definition

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

Lanczos options:
    -n, --nbr-eigen : number of eigenvalues (default value = 30)
    --full-diag : maximum Hilbert space dimension for which full diagonalization is applied (value must be greater than 100, default value = 500)
    --iter-max : maximum number of lanczos iteration (default value = 3000)
    --block-lanczos : use block Lanczos algorithm
    --block-size : size of the block used in the block Lanczos algorithm (default value = 2)
    --limit-time : use limit in time instead of a number of lanczos iteration (0 if none, time in seconds) (default value = 0)
    -d, --disk : enable disk resume capabilities
    -r, --resume : resume from disk datas
    --nbr-iter : number of lanczos iteration (for the current run) (default value = 3000)
    --nbr-vector : maximum number of vector in RAM during Lanczos iteration (default value = 10)
    --force-reorthogonalize : force to use Lanczos algorithm with reorthogonalizion even if the number of eigenvalues to evaluate is 1
    --set-reorthogonalize : force reorthogonalization with a set of vectors describe in the name of file passed through this option
    --eigenstate : evaluate eigenstates
    --all-eigenstates : evaluate all eigenstates when performing a full diagonalization
    --first-eigenstate : index of the first eigenstate to evaluate (default value = 0)
    --eigenstate-convergence : evaluate Lanczos convergence from eigenstate convergence
    --partial-eigenstate : evaluate eigenstates every given number of iterations (0 to discard this option) (default value = 0)
    --show-itertime : show time spent for each Lanczos iteration
    --initial-vector : use file as the initial vector for the Lanczos algorithm
    --initial-blockvectors : use file that describe a set of initial vectors for the block Lanczos algorithm (syntax : InitialVectors=vec0.vec vec1.vec ...)
    --partial-lanczos : only run a given number of Lanczos iterations
    --lanczos-precision : define Lanczos precision for eigenvalues (0 if automatically defined by the program) (default value = 0)
    --fast-disk : use disk storage to increase speed of ground state calculation and decrease memory footprint when using Lanczos algorithm
    --add-projector : use an additional projector on a subspace, the argument is a single column ASCII file that contains the list of vectors than define the projector
    --auto-addprojector : automatically the projector on the subspace of previously found eigenstates
    --addprojector-factor : set the energy scale factor in front of the projector when using --add-projector (default value = 10)
    --addprojector-noshift : do not shift the eigenstate indices when using the --add-projector
    --resume-fastdisk : resume the fast-disk mode Lanczos algorithm from a stopped one (for example due to computer crash)
    --noreplay-fastdisk : do not evaluate eigenvectors in fast-disk mode, exit the code, instead

precalculation options:
    -m, --memory : amount of memory that can be allocated for fast multiplication (in Mbytes) (default value = 1000)

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries

misc options:
    --show-hamiltonian : show Hamiltonian matrix, and exit
    --test-hermitian : Check hermitian symmetry, and exit
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
```
